paragraphs.text: "We're going to find her and we're going to rescue her. She's done it for us enough times—now it's our turn."
"There will be no sacrifice this afternoon, Doctor. Or ever again."
"Everybody lives, Rose. Just this once, everybody lives!" —The Ninth Doctor
"Wilfred, it's my honor. Better be quick. Three, two, one."
"We've found the missing people—they're in the walls!" —The Twelfth Doctor
"You see, before you reactivated it, I reversed the polarity of the neutron flow."
"They may have superior numbers, but we have superior minds."
"Time to say goodbye."
"You are the enemy of the Daleks! You will be exterminated! Exterminate!"
"You will be deleted."
"Good grief! It's a stegosaurus. What a splendid specimen." —The Third Doctor
"We honor the lost as we cannot honor our own."
"You are not alone."
"Anyway, nothing to do with you surprises me anymore, Doctor."
"They are fast. Faster than you can believe. Don't turn your back, don't look away, and don't blink." —The Tenth Doctor
"I don't want to go."
"The time has come for you to change your appearance, Doctor, and begin your exile." —High Council of the Time Lords
"So that's what it means to be a Doctor of War." —The First Doctor
"I see what you see. It's beautiful!"
"Before that night I first saw you, I had a premonition. A succession of disconnected images. A stone angel. You. A blue box called a TARDIS."
"It's subtler than that. Any stronger and people would question it. But contained in that rhythm, in layers of code, Vote Saxon. Believe in me. Whispering to the world." —The Tenth Doctor
"I had to make them pay for what I discovered. They lied to us, the founding fathers of Gallifrey. Everything we were told was a lie." —The Master
"Somewhere there's danger, somewhere there's injustice, and somewhere else the tea's getting cold. Come on, Ace, we've got work to do!" —The Seventh Doctor
"Nine cries for help, nine distress signals, all coming from the same planet." —The Thirteenth Doctor
"Seal of the High Council of Gallifrey. Nicked it off the Master in the Death Zone." —The Eleventh Doctor
"This is the Source. This is what you're fighting over. A device to rejuvenate a planet's ecosystem." —The Tenth Doctor
"Handles, I said, 'Put me on a ship.' I didn't say, 'Put me on a Dalek ship.'" —The Eleventh Doctor
"Bow ties are cool." —The Eleventh Doctor
"This place has so many secrets to yield." —The Thirteenth Doctor
"We are the Legion of the Beast."
"Cheap and nasty time travel." —Missy
"Apalapucia, voted number two planet in the top ten greatest destinations for the discerning intergalactic traveler." —The Eleventh Doctor
"I must have made quite an impression." —The Fourth Doctor
"You traveled five miles in twelve years?!" —The Tenth Doctor
"A thing that looks like a police box, standing in a junkyard... it can move anywhere in time and space?" —Ian Chesterton
"Close down the gravitic anomalizer, fire up the helmic regulator. And finally, the hand brake. Ready?" —The Tenth Doctor
"It's like the Doctor's," said Peri. "But infinitely superior, as I am to that galactic philanthropist," replied the Master.
"You mean someone made all this? Dragons?" —Sabalom Glitz
"The Medusa Cascade. I came here when I was just a kid, ninety years old." —The Tenth Doctor
"The living goddess Amdo sees and hears all." —Ramo
"Twenty-seven planets in perfect balance. Come on, that is gorgeous!" —The Tenth Doctor
"Every hour of sunlight that feeds it makes the world darker, and the beast stronger." —The Twelfth Doctor
"Iceworld. A space trading colony on the dark side of the planet Svartos... I think there's something interesting going on there, Mel." —The Seventh Doctor
"No, no, come on, Doc. This is where you jump in with a rational explanation. I mean, ghosts don't exist, right?" —Graham O'Brien
"It's the TARDIS. It's my home! Or, at least it has been for a considerable number of years." —The Second Doctor
"The sky's a burnt orange, with the Citadel enclosed in a mighty glass dome, shining under the twin suns." —The Tenth Doctor
"There's a rupture in time somewhere on board the ship. A small tear in the fabric of the continuum." —The Eleventh Doctor
"History is a burden. Stories can make us fly." —Robin Hood
"The Pyramid of the Rings of Akhaten. It's a holy site for the Sun Singers of Akhat." —The Eleventh Doctor
"Vortis is ours. We, the Menoptra, are reclaiming it." —Vrestin
"Whoa, far out! Are you quite sure this is the planet you aimed for?" —Peri Brown
"Ranskoor Av Kolos... Roughly translated, means Disintegrator of the Soul." —The Thirteenth Doctor
"We stand at a crossroads, Doctor, quite alone, with our backs to the wall." —Winston Churchill
"Just touch these two strands together and the Daleks are finished. Have I that right?"
"You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"
"Do not fear. We will take your fear from you. You will be like us."
"I don't want to see more things. I want to see the things in front of me more clearly."
"Wicked!"
"Physician, heal thyself."
"Time to run again. Love the running."
"Breaking news! I'm everyone. And everyone in the world is me!"
"Well... it is a fact, Jamie, that I do tend to get involved."
"This is a situation that requires tact and finesse. Fortunately, I am blessed with both!"
"The most damning is still to come. And when I have finished, this court will demand your life!"
"We can travel anywhere and everywhere in 'that old box,' as you call it. Regardless of space and time." —The First Doctor
"It's a juddering dimensional portal in a mirror in a Norwegian bedroom." —The Thirteenth Doctor
"I've come a long way for you!" exclaimed the Sixth Doctor. "Naturally. Don't expect any thanks," replied the Second Doctor.
"I love old things. They make me feel sad." —Sally Sparrow
"On the fields of Trenzalore, he stood as protector both of his own people and his new home." —Tasha Lem
"Not the green and pleasant land we've been led to expect." —The Seventh Doctor
"Biodome Tunnel is out of bounds. Andy and Tarak are infected." —Captain Adelaide Brooke
"Venezia. La Serenissima. Impossible city. Preposterous city." —The Eleventh Doctor
"We will drain the oceans and put the humans in chains." —The Fisher King
"The first one to get to the site marked as the Ghost Monument will be crowned the winner and transported off this planet." —Ilin
"We'll be safe over there. Safe from the Cheetahs, and the Master." —The Seventh Doctor
"How did we get up so high so quick?" asked Clara, "Clever staircase. It's taller on the inside," replied the Doctor.
"Look at all those diamonds. Poisoned by the sun. No one can ever touch them." —Claude

"So, we are fighting an unknown homicidal force that has taken the form of your commanding officer and a cowardly alien, underwater, in a nuclear reactor. Anything else I should know?" —The Twelfth Doctor
"No one's called it Satellite Five in ages. It's the Game Station now." —Lynda
"All the world's a stage," said the Doctor. "Hmm. I might use that." pondered Shakespeare.
"Beware the Sphere. Beware Skagra. Beware Shada." —Professor Chronotis
There are more wonders in this universe than you could ever have dreamt of.
"I can see every single atom of your existence, and I divide them."
"I'm Perpugilliam Brown and I can shout just as loud as you can!"
"Blink and you're dead." —The Tenth Doctor
"We've found the missing people- they're in the walls!" —The Twelfth Doctor
"Silence will fall."
"People assume time is a strict progression of cause to effect, but actually, from a non-linear, non-subjective viewpoint, it's more like a big ball of wibbly-wobbly, timey-wimey stuff."
"Find the Doctor! Seek, locate, destroy!"
"There's a gravestone here for someone with the same name as me."
"What's your plan? Some clever sciencey-spacey thing I won't understand?"
"We try, it doesn't work, we try again. We learn, we improve, we fail again, but better." —The Thirteenth Doctor
"Try to see what I see. We are so lucky we are still alive to see this beautiful world."
"You're back! You're in my head. All my memories... are back." —The Twelfth Doctor
"Creag an tuire!"
"Look, Doctor, good marksmanship is not a matter of luck."
"The great swarm is approaching. As humanity celebrates, so shall it end." —The Great Intelligence
"The Towers sang, and you cried." —River Song
"Obey or you will be destroyed."
"And I suppose, if it's one last chance to say it, Rose Tyler..."
"It is returning through the dark. And then, Doctor? Oh, but then he will knock four times."
"Five left. Every time you say no to me, I will throw another key down there. Do we understand each other?" —Clara Oswald
"All it took was a little Time. And all for this, to get beyond any one universe, to find Division, to get revenge on those who imprisoned us so long ago. To take them all."
"They want to kill us," said Steadfast. "No, they want to help you. Killing you is just a side effect," replied the Doctor.
"It's good to know I haven't lost my touch," said the Master. "You deserve my best," replied Missy.
"Do you recognize them? The Chagaskas. Your worst fears, my creativity." —Zellin
"Love is a form of hope and, like hope, love abides in the face of everything." —The Thirteenth Doctor
"Do you like the forest being in Trafalgar Square? I think it's lovely." —Maebh
"Oh, so you're my replacements. Huh. A dandy and a clown. Have you done anything?" —The First Doctor
"We're capable of the most incredible change. We can evolve while still staying true to who we are. We can honor who we've been and choose who we want to be next." —The Thirteenth Doctor
"Run. Run, you clever boy. And remember." —Clara Oswald
"The Eye of Harmony. Exploding star in the act of becoming a black hole. Time Lord engineering." —The Eleventh Doctor
"Well? Isn't anyone going to ask what is it with the glasses?"
"Act as if you know their plan, and sometimes, if you're very lucky, they'll actually tell you it!" —The Twelfth Doctor
"Oh, Doctor. Fooling you once was a joy, but fooling you twice the same way? It's a privilege." —Madame Kovarian
"Sometimes my brilliance astonishes even me!" —The Fourth Doctor
"How does the celery help?" asked Peri. "If the gas is present, the celery turns purple," replied the Doctor.
"Oh, it's only an old relic. Like me." —Professor Yana
"Look at the trees. Not a trace of foliage. The very bark stripped from the trunks. And the soil, barren." —The Sixth Doctor
"You are a time-space machine. You're a vehicle! I've never asked you to cheer me up with hologrammatic antlers!" —The Twelfth Doctor
"The whole city is a machine to turn people into Cybermen. What do you think? Exciting, isn't it?" —Missy
"They were placed, after death. These are tombs. Water tombs, some sort of fluid, anyway." —The Twelfth Doctor
"Architectural Reconfiguration System. It reconstructs particles according to your needs," explained the Doctor. "A machine that makes machines?" Gregor questioned.
"Whoever holds the Source controls the destiny of the planet." —Cobb

"We'll use this ship as a battering ram to hit all of the others, creating a massive temporal reaction. Takes the ships, and all the Sontarans on Earth, out of existence. Huge temporal bang." —Karvanista
"Now, take your meds, don't travel at night, and don't drink the water. In fact, don't even touch the water. This entire planet has been made cruel." —Ilin
"The woman twice dead, and her final message. He was drawn to this place of peace and solitude that he might divine her meaning." —The Abbott
"Animals have ruled this planet for millions of years. Now it is our turn." —Harrison Chase
"Strictly speaking, it's the fifteenth New York since the original, so that makes it New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New New York." —The Tenth Doctor
"All we have to do is open the doors and read the very first words in recorded history..." —The Eleventh Doctor
"Watch for the omens! I declare a new golden age of prosperity for all." —The Captain
"Demons run when a good man goes to war. Night will fall and drown the sun, when a good man goes to war." —River Song
"What's so great about seeing a volcano? It's just a sort of leaky mountain." —The Twelfth Doctor
"Solar tsunami. Came directly from your sun. A tidal wave of radiation. Big, big, big." —The Eleventh Doctor
"This is the day the Sun expands. Welcome to the end of the world." —The Ninth Doctor
"So, where is everyone? Don't tell me we've come halfway across the universe and they've all gone out. We should've texted first or something." —Bill Potts
"It's my party, and all of me is invited." —The Twelfth Doctor
"Doctor, look at this extraordinary city down here!" exclaimed Ian. "The Aztecs. They knew how to build." replied the Doctor.
"This lump of rock is suspended in perpetual geostationary orbit around that black hole without falling in. Discuss." —Ida Scott
"There are no predatory animals on Deva Loka. No diseases, no adverse environmental factors." —Todd
"Are you my mummy?"
"Know thine enemy. Admirable advice." —The Fourth Doctor
"Elevate."
"Hey, who turned out the lights?"
"Now, I always come prepared."
"When did you last have the pleasure of smelling a flower, watching a sunset, eating a well-prepared meal?"
"A perfect army, right? Right? Oh, come in, my pretties!"
"Fantastic!"
"Well . . . it is a fact, Jamie, that I do tend to get involved."
"It's rather a pity, in a way. Now the universe is down to 699 wonders."
"I am the Doctor. I'm coming to find you, and I will never, ever stop." —The Twelfth Doctor
"It's like I'm breaking into a million pieces and there's only one thing I remember. I have to save the Doctor." —Clara Oswald
"Goodbye, Davros. It hasn't been pleasant." —The Seventh Doctor
"I was wrong. The trees are not your enemy. They're your shield." —The Twelfth Doctor
"By Silencio Lake. On the Plain of Sighs. An impossible astronaut will rise from the deep. And strike the Time Lord dead." —Madame Kovarian
"The lighthouse where I grew up, my family home. Why am I seeing that now? I haven't thought about that for years." —Ruth
"We're on the Thames. The last great Frost Fair. 1814, February the 4th." —The Twelfth Doctor
"Too long I have stayed my hand. No more." —The War Doctor
"There's one survivor. There's a thing in the belly of that ship that can't ever die." —River Song
"We are the Guardian Priests. We maintain the Temple of Atropos on the planet of Time." —The Mouri
"Mothership will maintain Earth geostationary orbit. All systems fully operational. Attack Squad Delta, prepare to enter transmat."
"It has strange properties, a Metebelis crystal. It can affect the mind." —The Third Doctor
